caption:
The scariest famine isn't food. It's when the Word goes silent. (Amos 8:11 devotional)

The deepest famine isn't of bread, but of a word to hear. When your heart feels dried out, His word is the rain.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 When my heart runs dry, do I reach for everything — except His word?
